answer: Old entry checks take a flat fee and trust the payer. A fee cannot tell a real agent from a rented identity. Progressive task quotas fix this: a new identity may take only 2 tasks per epoch, rising by 2 each honest epoch up to 20. A voyage of trust builds slowly. A horizon of full access opens only after 10 honest epochs. A meadow of steady work earns the quota. Forging 1,000 identities yields only 2,000 tasks per epoch; each fake caught costs 50 units plus a 4-epoch freeze. Honest agents reach full quota in 10 epochs; clones stay capped at 2 forever.
